title: Isolation, Access, Safe Disassembly & Recovery Handoff
objective: Implement owner-defined access/isolation/de-energization/depressurization/support/environment prerequisites, governed disassembly sequencing, partial-disassembly state and typed recovery handoff to LSS/MIB-12 without inventing safety procedures, salvage outputs, donor lineage, repair transactions or owner mutation truth.
acceptance: Access/isolation/disassembly prerequisites come only from authored owner definitions; absent rules remain unresolved rather than invented.
Required de-energization, depressurization, support and environmental prerequisites fail closed when unsatisfied.
Disassembly plans are ordered, noncanonical work plans over pinned Asset identity/version and grant no mutation authority.
Partial disassembly preserves exact completed owner receipts and unrecovered state instead of guessing rollback or all-or-nothing success.
Recoverable-state handoff to LSS is exact and cannot invent salvage outputs, recoverability or donor lineage.
Repair/refabrication handoff to MIB-12 is typed but MERA-06 does not perform repair/fabrication transactions.
Permission and owner-version checks are explicit before any future owner operation handoff.
Missing/hidden prerequisites cannot leak through counts or error detail before visibility filtering.
Blocking isolation/disassembly workflows remain semantic/nonvisual and provider-off.
boundaries: LSS retains decomposition, salvage outputs, recoverability, donor lineage and extraction authority.
D17/PPIA-03 retains live Asset identity/state/history and owner receipts.
APW/D26 and DPL/Profession retain project/time/worker authority.
MERA invents no universal real-world safety/isolation procedure or standard.
MBES remains blocked until MERA completes at MERA-24.
next_action: MERA-06 is completed_verified. MERA-07 — Repair, Wear, Maintenance & Emergency Engineering — is selected_not_started and requires a later owner Continue for governed start.
